topic: Which faction to pick (and in what order)
text: Pick ONE faction and build its meta team first; free players start No Org (cheapest), then Aogiri, then CCG, Anteiku last. One-faction teams are what every guide team is.

topic: Early mistakes that waste resources (with the cost)
text: The expensive early mistakes are all about pulls and Diamonds: starting a banner you cannot finish, pulling shop units, pulling outside your faction, skipping timers with Diamonds, levelling everyone, and buying outside a rebate window.

topic: The first pulls: what to save for, what to skip
text: Do not pull early. Save Diamonds and tickets for ONE banner you can finish in your faction: a limited unit is guaranteed at 300 pulls (90,000 Diamonds), a non-limited rate-up at 200 (60,000), and pity does not carry over. Skip any banner whose unit comes to a shop later (Juzo [CCG Maverick] day 15, Uta [Mask-Maker] day 29).
Stronghold Annihilation is the org war for the top 3 organizations of the weekly Stronghold Takeover: 1 team per battle, each stronghold has a minimum CP, HP carries over.

topic: Scenes (CG collection) and the Scene calculator
text: 91 scenes in 6 groups (All Characters: 12, All Characters (New): 18, Anteiku: 14, Aogiri: 14, CCG: 19, No Org: 14). Each scene levels up with Scene points and gives a flat stat to a faction (or all characters); organization and rarity requirements gate the higher levels. Faction scenes only boost that faction, so pour points into the faction you actually field. Full per-level table: data/sources/gluttony_db_latest.json -> scenes.

Modification: 4 slots, 3 options offered per round, 30 rounds. Starting values ATK 30, DEF 25, HP 160. Caps per line: AtkFixed 700, DefFixed 550, HpFixed 11000, AtkRate 0.016, DefRate 0.016, HpRate 0.016, Crit 0.035, Uncrit 0.035, CritDeepen 0.04, UncritDeepen 0.04, Block 0.04, Unblock 0.04, Suck 0.03, Regeneration 0.03, GetCured 0.03. Crit/CritDeepen/Block lines cap at 3.5-4%; ATK% lines cap at 1.6%, so on a damage dealer CRIT DMG (CritDeepen) and Crit are the lines to keep.
